rules.UNITS: get_account amounts are integer cents; the brief, floors and checks are in dollars; create_promise takes integer cents (amount_cents).
rules.DEADLINE: Band 1 (1-30): CARD 7th / AUTO 3rd business day after today. Band 2 (31-75): CARD last business day of the month (next month's if today is that day), AUTO 2nd business day after today.
rules.FLOOR: CARD 12% of overdue rounded up to whole dollar, min $35, whole debt if below $35. AUTO band 1 monthly payment; AUTO band 2 whole overdue.
rules.LADDER: Step 1 full on deadline; step 2 (band 2) floor on deadline; a repeated step is skipped and not counted. Attempts: band 1 one, band 2 two.
rules.IDENTITY: zip_code (5 digits, leading zero kept) then ssn_last4; three wrong answers.
